versions.name: Camp Davy Crockett

features.note: Scouts can attend provisionally in a week other than their troop's.
Nine miles of shoreline on Cherokee Lake.

versions.summary: Sequoyah Council's Scouts BSA resident summer camp spanning 1,865 acres in the foothills of the Great Smoky Mountains along Cherokee Lake, offering 50+ merit badges, Frontier Camp living history, COPE and climbing, aquatics, and horsemanship.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence). This survey is deliberately thin: the camp page presents its programme as image-only tabs (Eagle Bound, Frontier Camp) whose text could not be read, so those tracks are unrecorded rather than guessed.
